title: Follow-Up: Mapping the Conditions Under Which Opus 4.5 Does Course-Correct

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Understanding when models do course-correct reveals protective conditions that can be engineered or amplified. Direct chain from analysis to actionable deployment interventions. The 10%/16.5%/37% baselines provide clear targets for improvement.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires generating a labeled dataset of pressure trials (API-based), separating correction/non-correction cases, feature extraction, and building a classifier. The ML pipeline (logistic regression) is beginner-accessible, but the dataset generation and feature design require judgment.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Dataset construction + feature analysis + classifier building is a multi-step pipeline. Each step is manageable but together they fill 30 hours. Could be narrowed by focusing on qualitative analysis without the classifier.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
